plans.name: Essential Health Plan
plans.shortDescription: Simple, affordable online healthcare with monthly access to one GP consultation, secure video consultations, and convenient management of your health.
plans.longDescription:
The Essential Health Plan offers a simple, convenient and affordable way to look after your health, wherever you are.
With this plan, you get 1 credit per month for a consultation with a GP, through secure online and video consultations. You can also book your appointments online and access your medical records through the Global Health platform.
A practical solution for your everyday health needs, without having to visit a clinic for every consultation.
The Essential Health Plan includes: • 1 credit per month for a GP consultation
• Secure online and video consultations
• Online booking
• Access to your medical records
• A simple and convenient way to manage your health needs
features: 1 online GP consultation credit each month
Online booking and access to your records

plans.name: Comprehensive Health Plan
plans.shortDescription: More access to online healthcare, with 2 monthly credits for GP consultations, secure video consultations and convenient management of your health.
plans.longDescription:
The Comprehensive Health Plan offers greater access to online healthcare, providing a practical and convenient way to manage your regular health needs.
With this plan, you get 2 credits per month for consultations with a GP, through secure online and video consultations. You can also book your appointments online and access your medical records through the Global Health platform.
It is a solution designed for those looking for more regular access to healthcare, with the convenience of online consultations and no unnecessary travel.
The Comprehensive Health Plan includes: • 2 credits per month for GP consultations
• Secure online and video consultations
• Online booking
• Access to your medical records
• Greater flexibility to manage your regular health needs
features: 2 online GP consultation credits each month
Online booking and access to your records

plans.name: Premium Health & Wellness Plan
plans.shortDescription: Complete online healthcare for you and your wellbeing, with 3 GP consultations per month and secure video consultations.
plans.longDescription:
The Premium Health & Wellness Plan was created for those looking for regular monitoring of their health, with easy and convenient access to medical care.
The plan includes 3 GP consultations per month, allowing you to address health concerns, monitor conditions and get medical guidance in a simple and convenient way.
Look after your health continuously, preventively and affordably, with the support of a qualified medical network.
features: 3 online GP consultation credits each month
Online booking and access to your records
